# Preface {.unnumbered}

This guide accompanies **Q-CRAFT Explorer**, a Python reimplementation of the IMF's Quantitative Climate Risk Assessment Fiscal Tool. It is written for economists and policymakers who use fiscal projection tools in their work.

The guide has three parts:

1. **Policy Relevance and How Q-CRAFT Works** — the economic methodology, explained for practitioners
2. **Using the Explorer** — parameter-by-parameter guidance for running your own projections
3. **Co-Design and the SovTech Vision** — how to shape the next version of this tool

::: {.callout-note}
## This is an initial version
Q-CRAFT Explorer is a starting point, not a finished product. We want to co-design the next version with you. See [Part 3](part3-codesign.qmd) for how to get involved.
:::
